metas.name: The Office
metas.description: The daily absurdities of Dunder Mifflin paper company employees under the world's best (worst) boss, Michael Scott — the definitive mockumentary comedy.

metas.name: Parks and Recreation
metas.description: Eternally optimistic Leslie Knope and her misfit colleagues run the parks department of Pawnee, Indiana.

metas.name: 30 Rock
metas.description: Behind the scenes of a fictional sketch show, with its frazzled head writer, vain star, and eccentric network executive.

metas.name: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
metas.description: Detective Jake Peralta and the detectives of Brooklyn's 99th precinct solve crimes under their by-the-book new captain.

metas.name: The Good Place
metas.description: Eleanor Shellstrop wakes up in the afterlife's 'Good Place' — a mistake, since she was a terrible person — and tries to become good.

metas.name: Superstore
metas.description: The employees of big-box store Cloud 9 navigate retail absurdity, workplace romance, and found family.

metas.name: Suits
metas.description: A brilliant college dropout with a photographic memory talks his way into a job at a top Manhattan law firm.

metas.name: Mr. Robot
metas.description: A cybersecurity engineer and hacker is recruited by a mysterious anarchist to take down the world's most powerful corporation.

metas.name: Psych
metas.description: A fake psychic detective and his best friend solve crimes for the Santa Barbara police with hyper-observant comedy.

metas.name: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit
metas.description: The NYPD's Special Victims Unit investigates sexually based crimes, led for decades by Olivia Benson.

metas.name: Chicago Fire
metas.description: The firefighters and paramedics of Firehouse 51 risk their lives on every call in Chicago.

metas.name: Friday Night Lights
metas.description: High school football is everything in Dillon, Texas, where Coach Taylor leads the Panthers through triumph and heartbreak.

metas.name: Heroes
metas.description: Ordinary people around the world discover extraordinary abilities — and a destiny to 'save the cheerleader, save the world.'

metas.name: The Magicians
metas.description: Graduate students at a secret magic university in New York discover that a darker, adult Narnia is real.

metas.name: Eureka
metas.description: A U.S. Marshal becomes sheriff of Eureka, a secret town populated by the world's most brilliant scientists and their disastrous experiments.

metas.name: Warehouse 13
metas.description: Secret Service agents collect dangerous supernatural artifacts for a mysterious government warehouse.

metas.name: 12 Monkeys
metas.description: A time traveler is sent back to stop a plague that wipes out humanity, based on the Terry Gilliam film.

metas.name: Resident Alien
metas.description: A stranded alien posing as a small-town doctor struggles with his mission to destroy humanity as he grows fond of it.

metas.name: Chucky
metas.description: The killer doll returns to Hackensack, New Jersey, continuing the Child's Play saga with a new generation of victims.

metas.name: Ted
metas.description: Set in 1993, foul-mouthed teddy bear Ted and 16-year-old John Bennett navigate high school together in the prequel to the films.

metas.name: Bel-Air
metas.description: A dramatic reimagining of The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air, following Will's journey from West Philadelphia to the Banks family's mansion.

metas.name: Twisted Metal
metas.description: A motor-mouthed outsider delivers packages across a post-apocalyptic wasteland, facing deranged marauders — including Sweet Tooth.

metas.name: Young Rock
metas.description: Dwayne Johnson recounts his wild life story across three eras, from wrestling-obsessed kid to Hollywood star.

metas.name: The Mindy Project
metas.description: OB/GYN Mindy Lahiri balances a chaotic personal life with her medical career in this sharp romantic comedy.

metas.name: Unbreakable Kimmy Schmidt
metas.description: After 15 years in an underground cult, Kimmy Schmidt restarts her life in New York with unbreakable optimism.

metas.name: Will & Grace
metas.description: Best friends Will, a gay lawyer, and Grace, an interior designer, navigate life, love, and their eccentric friends in Manhattan.

metas.name: Magnum, P.I.
metas.description: Private investigator Thomas Magnum solves cases in Hawaii while living the good life on a beachfront estate.

metas.name: Quantum Leap
metas.description: Physicist Sam Beckett leaps through time into other people's lives, guided by hologram Al, trying to get home.

metas.name: Knight Rider
metas.description: Michael Knight and his artificially intelligent car KITT fight crime across America.
